text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai!! Hiding the birthday 
presents everyone gave me is just too 
cruel!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Windy-chan doesn't care! I'm just 
gonna do whatever I want!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've hidden your presents all over the 
academy! Biko getting all pampered just 
'cause it's her birthday deserves to 
suffer a whole bunch, you know--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If it's the presents, I found them all 
using my hero powers!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All of it!? Wait... R-Really, the whole 
thing!? Already!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter how evil their 
schemes are, justice will always prevail 
in the end!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So don't go pulling any more pranks, got 
it?! And another thing—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh... W-What's with this all of a 
sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There was one extra hidden present! This 
one's gotta be from Windy-senpai, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't know either? I have absolutely 
noooo clue what you're talking about!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right! Then even if I don't know who 
sent it, I'll be sure to say a proper 
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To someboody out theeeere!!! Thank you for 
the present, I got it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, too loud, too loud! You don't need 
to shout that loud for me to hear youuu!
